title: [RPG Review] Etrian Odyssey III: The Drowned City

blocks.translation: [RPG Review] Etrian Odyssey III: The Drowned City

blocks.source: シリーズ初挑戦なので、その前提でレビュー。
blocks.translation: This is my review from the perspective of someone playing the series for the first time.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Length / Story

blocks.source: ラスボス撃破までプレイ。プレイ時間の表記はないけれど６～７０時間ぐらい？
blocks.translation: I played until defeating the final boss. There is no playtime listed, but perhaps around 6–70 hours?

blocks.source: 普通にクリアするだけでも大変だったので、裏ボスは保留。
blocks.translation: Even simply clearing the game normally was difficult, so I am leaving the superbosses for later.

blocks.source: 海都を舞台に冒険者達が迷宮へ挑む。
blocks.translation: Adventurers take on the labyrinth, with the ocean city as their base.

blocks.source: ダンジョンＲＰＧなので、それほどストーリー性が強いわけではないけれど、世界設定はそれなりに作りこまれている。
blocks.translation: As a dungeon RPG, it is not particularly story-driven, but its worldbuilding is fairly elaborate.

blocks.source: ストーリー分岐があって、ラスボスが変化したりもする。データを引き継いでの周回もできるとはいえ、さすがに最初からやり直すのは大変だと思うけれど。
blocks.translation: There are story branches, and even the final boss can change. Although you can play through again while carrying over your data, starting over from the beginning would still be quite a challenge.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: クラスと名前を自分で決めて、キャラクターを作成し冒険する。
blocks.translation: You choose your own classes and names, then create characters and set out on an adventure.

blocks.source: システムはシリーズを経る中で、複雑ながらも練りこまれている。
blocks.translation: The systems have become increasingly complex yet well-crafted over the course of the series.

blocks.source: 多数のクラスが登場。中盤からはサブクラスとして、もう一つのクラスに就くことができる。
blocks.translation: A large number of classes appear. From the middle of the game onward, you can take on another class as a subclass.

blocks.source: レベルが上がる度に獲得できるポイントを使用して、スキルを習得する形式。
blocks.translation: The game uses a system in which you spend points earned whenever you level up to learn skills.

blocks.source: スキルの習得条件はやや複雑。例えば「スキルＡの習得条件はスキルＢをＬｖ５、スキルＣをＬｖ３まで習得すること」といった感じになっている。時折、どのスキルを目指していたのか、忘れて悩んでしまうことも。
blocks.translation: The requirements for learning skills are somewhat complex. For example, one might require you to learn Skill A by reaching Skill B Lv. 5 and Skill C Lv. 3. Sometimes I would forget which skill I was working toward and get stuck wondering what to do.

blocks.source: 個人的にもシステム制作の参考になりそう。実際にこれの影響を受けたかのようなシステム設計をしているフリゲも見かける。
blocks.translation: It also seems like a useful reference for designing systems. I have even seen freeware games with systems that appear to have been influenced by this one.

blocks.source: 戦闘は高速でテンポよく進む。
blocks.translation: Battles proceed quickly and at a good pace.

blocks.source: ただし、高難易度として名高いシリーズだけあって、一筋縄ではいかない。ザコ敵は強くしぶといので、総合的な戦闘時間も結構長い。
blocks.translation: However, this is a series renowned for its high difficulty, so things are never that simple. Regular enemies are strong and persistent, making battles fairly lengthy overall.

blocks.source: ダンジョン内をうろつくＦＯＥと呼ばれる強敵も存在する。初見で挑むと大抵は全滅させられるが、回避もできる。強くなってから挑むのも自由。
blocks.translation: There are also powerful enemies called FOEs that wander around the dungeons. If you take them on without knowing what to expect, they will usually wipe out your party, but they can also be avoided. You are free to challenge them after growing stronger.

blocks.source: ……と、ここまではどうにかなる難易度。
blocks.translation: ...Up to this point, the difficulty is manageable.

blocks.source: さらに辛いのは各階層のボス。
blocks.translation: The bosses on each floor are even more punishing.

blocks.source: これは非常に強い上、長期戦になる。初見殺しの攻撃も多く、対策必須のボスも多数登場するので、かなり大変。というか、ガチで難しいので後半は攻略みないとやってられなかった。
blocks.translation: They are extremely powerful and lead to long battles. Many use attacks that can kill you if you encounter them unprepared, and numerous bosses require specific countermeasures, making them quite difficult. In fact, the game is genuinely hard, and I could not get through the latter half without consulting walkthroughs.

blocks.source: それでいてボス戦前のセーブポイントはなく、全滅はゲームオーバーになるという鬼仕様。もっとも、ショートカットを活用すれば５～１０分程度でボスの元までたどり着ける。それで、どうにか心を折らずに進めた。
blocks.translation: Despite that, there are no save points before boss battles, and a total party wipe results in a game over—truly brutal design. Fortunately, using shortcuts lets you reach the boss in about 5–10 minutes. That was just enough to keep me moving forward without losing heart.

blocks.source: これらは昔のゲームによくある調整不足ではなく、計算づくの高難易度。手応えを求めるプレイヤーにはおすすめ。ただし、ライトユーザは心を折るかも。これでも、前作、前前作より簡単だそうです。
blocks.translation: This is not the kind of poor balancing often seen in old games, but deliberately calculated high difficulty. I recommend it to players looking for a challenge. However, it may break the spirit of more casual users. Even so, I hear it is easier than the previous two games.

blocks.source: ……難しいと書いたけれど、補助系のスキルをうまく活用するととんでもないダメージを叩き出せるらしい。多数のスキルを重ねがければ、ダメージ２０倍も出せるとか。僕はそこまでやり込んでいないのだけれど。
blocks.translation: ...I called it difficult, but apparently you can deal tremendous damage by making good use of support skills. By stacking multiple skills, you can supposedly deal up to 20 times the damage. I did not delve that deeply into the game, though.

blocks.source: システム上、新しいスキルを次々覚えるというよりは、一つのスキルのレベルをどんどん高めることが多い。この方式の欠点として、使う技が固定になりやすい。サブクラスによってある程度緩和されているけれど、同じ技の連発でやや単調かと思うこともあった。
blocks.translation: Because of the system, you tend to raise the level of a single skill higher and higher rather than learning a succession of new skills. One drawback of this approach is that the techniques you use tend to become fixed. Subclasses mitigate this to some extent, but there were times when repeatedly using the same technique felt somewhat monotonous.

blocks.source: 出現する敵の種類は意外と少ない。ただ、一つ一つの敵は個性的。敵パーティの組み合わせによって、行動パターンを変えることもあるので、ザコだと侮ると痛い目にあったりする。
blocks.translation: There are surprisingly few types of enemies. However, each individual enemy is distinctive. They may even change their behavior depending on the enemy party composition, so underestimating them as mere grunts can lead to painful consequences.

blocks.source: このシリーズの特徴として、タッチペンを使用したマッピングがある。
blocks.translation: One feature of this series is mapping with a stylus.

blocks.source: 探検感はあるけれど、ボタン操作とタッチペンの両方を多用するので、疲れるかもしれない。なんせ、一階層を攻略するのに１０時間以上普通にかかるので。
blocks.translation: It gives you a real sense of exploration, but you may find it tiring since you use both the buttons and the stylus extensively. After all, it normally takes more than 10 hours to conquer a single floor.

blocks.source: ３独自の要素として『大航海』がある。海都の外に出て、船でマップ探索をするというもの。
blocks.translation: A feature unique to III is the “Great Voyage.” You leave the ocean city and explore the map by ship.

blocks.source: 大航海といいながらも、内容はパズル的。決められた行動数で、目的地を目指していく。
blocks.translation: Despite being called a great voyage, it is more puzzle-like in practice. You make your way toward your destination using a set number of moves.

blocks.source: 難易度は結構高い。これも攻略を見ないとやってられないと思う。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is fairly high. I do not think I could get through this without consulting a walkthrough either.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 硬派なゲームデザインにかわいらしいキャラデザが特徴というシリーズ。
blocks.translation: The series is characterized by its serious game design paired with cute character designs.

blocks.source: ドット絵のモンスターはかわいらしくても凶悪。
blocks.translation: The pixel-art monsters may look cute, but they are vicious.

blocks.source: 仲間キャラは同じクラスであっても４パターン（×２カラー）のグラフィックが選択可能。自分の好みに合うものを選択できる。
blocks.translation: Even when they belong to the same class, party members can have graphics selected from four patterns (× 2 colors). You can choose the one that best suits your preferences.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: ファルコム作品などで有名な古代祐三。あえてレトロチックな音にしているらしいが、曲は王道で好印象。
blocks.translation: Yuzo Koshiro is famous for works such as those by Falcom. Apparently, he deliberately gave the music a retro sound, but the songs are classic and leave a good impression.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 面白い……けど、ほとほと疲れ果てた。
blocks.translation: It was fun... but I was completely exhausted.

blocks.source: 続けて同シリーズ作品に手を出すには、相当な気力と時間が必要になりそう。ストーリー性も高くないから、似たようなことを繰り返すんだろうな――と、どうしても後ろ向きになってしまう。
blocks.translation: Continuing on to another game in the same series would probably require a considerable amount of energy and time. Since the story is not particularly substantial, I cannot help feeling pessimistic, thinking, “I would just be repeating much the same thing again.”

blocks.source: なので他作品への挑戦はとりあえず保留。
blocks.translation: So, for the time being, I’ll put trying my hand at other works on hold.

blocks.source: 女神転生シリーズにも同じような感想を持ったけれど、やっぱりダンジョンと戦闘ばかりの上に、プレイ時間も長いから大変。
blocks.translation: I had a similar impression of the Shin Megami Tensei series, but it’s still tough because it consists mostly of dungeons and battles, and the playtime is long.

blocks.source: 考えてみれば、昔のゲームは難しくても大抵は数十時間で終わるぐらいの規模だった。おまけにゲームバランスやプログラムの粗さから抜け道があったりもした。そのお陰で何とか気力が持ったのだろうな――と、しみじみ。
blocks.translation: Come to think of it, even when old games were difficult, they were generally small enough to finish in a few dozen hours. On top of that, their rough game balance and programming sometimes left loopholes to exploit. I suppose that helped me somehow keep my motivation going—so I reflect wistfully.
